items.title: Henry Russ Interview, 1972-01-18
items.q: Willie Connich. Played with that band about two years.

ctx.x: playing bass, father. Uh-huh. So Dumaine taught you both trumpet and drums?

Uh-huh. Yeah. He taught me both trumpet and drums. Uh-huh. Lewis Dumaine and George McCullum. I see. You heard the talking. Yeah. Uh-huh. Well, I went on from there, and when I was playing about, just about four years, I thought of playing with Lewis Dumaine. Lewis Dumaine said, well, don't you learn how to read? He was very strict, you know. He was mostly, that's the most he could play. About music, he couldn't play, couldn't play, you know. But I, I, the other guy said, man, you learn how to read, man, you're…
Who was in that band? Huh?
